issues.legal_issue: Land subject to a transfer must be excluded as far as possible when determining surplus land, even where the transfer is found not to be bona fide.
material_facts: The proceeding concerned determination of surplus land under land-ceiling law.
The land subject to the transfer was identifiable as a particular plot.
The Prescribed Authority found that the transfer was not bona fide, a finding the court assumed to be correct.
The Prescribed Authority did not exclude the transferred area when determining surplus land.
issues.conclusion: The court set aside the judgments of the High Court and the Prescribed Authority and remitted the matter for redetermination of surplus land, excluding the transferred area as far as possible.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 12A(d) of the applicable Act, the surplus-land determination must exclude the area subject to the transfer as far as possible, even on the assumption that the finding that the transfer was not bona fide is correct. The judgment relies on no earlier cases.

rule.if: surplus_land_determination and identifiable_transferred_area and transfer_found_not_bona_fide and transferred_area_not_excluded

predicates.surplus_land_determination: The proceeding concerns determination of the area of land that is surplus.
predicates.identifiable_transferred_area: A particular area of land is identifiable as the subject of a transfer.
predicates.transfer_found_not_bona_fide: The authority determining surplus land found that the transfer was not bona fide.
predicates.transferred_area_not_excluded: The authority determining surplus land did not exclude the transferred area from its determination.
predicates.transferred_area_excluded_as_far_as_poss: The transferred area is excluded from the surplus-land determination as far as possible.

issues.definition: When a surplus-land determination involves an identifiable transferred area that the authority has not excluded despite finding the transfer not bona fide, the transferred area is excluded as far as possible.
